Key.Original: chess - play chess against another computer on the network. The match runs on the server, so it can be left and picked up again later. At the lobby, type new to open a table, join followed by a table number to take a seat, or resume to go back to a match this computer already sits at. In a match, enter moves from square to square, for example e2e4; castle by moving the king two squares, e1g1. A pawn reaching the last rank becomes a queen. En passant is not available. Type board to redraw, status for the current situation, leave to give up the seat, or quit to close the game and keep the seat. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.

Key.Original: battleship - play battleship against another computer on the network. Both fleets are placed at random when the match starts, five ships each of five, four, three, three and two squares. Fire by naming a square, b5 or e10. A hit fires again. Key.Original: Play blackjack with up to eight computers on the network
Key.English: Play blackjack with up to eight computers on the network

Key.Original: blackjack - play blackjack with up to eight computers on the network against an automatic dealer. Open a table with new, let others join, then start it with start; a full table starts itself. Type hit to take a card or stand to keep your hand. The dealer draws to seventeen once every player is done, and the first seat to win three rounds takes the match. Type deal to start the next round. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.

Key.Original: Play checkers against another computer on the network
Key.English: Play checkers against another computer on the network

Key.Original: checkers - play checkers against another computer on the network. At the lobby, type new to open a table, join followed by a number to take a seat, or resume followed by a number to go back to a match. In a match, move a piece by naming two squares, c3d4, and jump with c3e5. A capture on offer has to be taken, and a piece that can keep jumping keeps the turn. A piece reaching the far row becomes a king and may move in every diagonal direction. Type board to redraw, status for the current situation, leave to give up the seat, or quit to close the game and keep it. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.

Key.Original: Play ludo with up to four computers on the network
Key.English: Play ludo with up to four computers on the network

Key.Original: ludo - play ludo with up to four computers on the network. Open a table with new, let others join, then start it with start; a full table starts itself. A turn is two steps: type roll, then the number of the token to move. A token leaves the yard on a six, and a six, a capture or a token reaching home all roll again. Landing on a square held by a single opposing token sends it back to its yard. Reaching home needs the exact number. A token at 0 is in the yard and one at 57 is home. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.

Both players throw at the same time, so you may throw whenever you like and your throw is not shown to the other player until theirs is in. Type rock, paper or scissors, or just r, p or s. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.

Key.Original: Play snakes and ladders with up to four computers on the network
Key.English: Play snakes and ladders with up to four computers on the network

Key.Original: snakesladders - play snakes and ladders with up to four computers on the network. Open a table with new, let others join, then start it with start; a full table starts itself. Type roll to take your turn. A six rolls again, a ladder carries your token up, a snake takes it down, and a roll that would pass one hundred does not move. First token to land on one hundred exactly wins. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.

Key.Original: Play uno with up to eight computers on the network
Key.English: Play uno with up to eight computers on the network

Key.Original: uno - play uno with up to eight computers on the network. Open a table with new, let others join, then start it with start once at least two seats are taken; a full table starts itself. Cards are written as a colour letter and a value: R5, G+2 for a draw two, Bs for a skip, Yr for a reverse, W for a wild and W4 for a wild draw four. Type play followed by a card, adding a colour for a wild, as in play W r, or draw to take a card and pass. First to empty their hand wins. Type seatname followed by a name to choose what this seat is called at the table, or seatname on its own to go back to the computer's name.
